nodes.name: Run provider component check manually
nodes.notes: Independent provider component test only. No Bubble endpoint, webhook, callback, NotificationLog write or email. Keep inactive and retention OFF. A green workflow alone is not a pass: final Validate AI summary output must have valid=true and be reviewed.

nodes.name: Request guard
nodes.notes: Validates real supplied AUTH001 book figures and computes totals/statuses through the exact local helpers. Request metadata is test-only; no source record is changed. Email and phone are absent. Node name preserves the frozen Build grounded prompt dependency; it is not a static-data lock.

nodes.name: OpenRouter AI
nodes.notes: Select the existing Header Auth account 2 only if it holds the approved NEW OpenRouter key. Never reuse the exposed portfolio key. Exact frozen HTTP parameters, timeout and retry behavior are preserved. No new credential is created by this reference.

nodes.name: Validate AI summary
nodes.notes: Inspect this output, not just node colors: valid=true plus a reviewed subject/body establishes only the provider component. valid=false is a controlled rejection even if n8n marks the overall manual run green. No callback or NotificationLog write occurs.
